finding: A predeclared review-required saliency fallback increases checked derived-mask pairs from 10/32 to 12/32. One added checker-heart fit still has conspicuous seams; low image error and valid geometry do not establish recovery of original cutting paths.

runtime.scope: Actual desktop Chromium WASM fields feed the crop/fitting comparison. Cached inference is excluded from paired pipeline timings. No phone, cold-start end-to-end, or production integration benchmark.

limits: Selection is new to recorded pipeline fitting experiments, not a new-source or unseen-motif test. Prior contact sheets may include these photos.
Five connected source groups; Sabrina, Flettede and DanishThings each contribute ten photos. Cases 23 and 32 appear to share a motif/photo despite separate catalog near-duplicate groups.
All 32 remain in the denominator, including an open basket and possible irregular designs. No proof of model impossibility without original templates.

Every existing production crop is retained by policy, including five weak outlines; unchanged fits are reused exactly. This establishes preservation by construction, not independent paired timing evidence.
Printed-paper boundaries are a major classification failure. Case 29 passes mask and paper checks but traces printed art rather than recovering the original physical weave.
Partial-photo proposals always require crop review. Unobserved padding is excluded from independent image-error measurement.
Both raw-probability and exact half-threshold numerical gates fail on fresh photos. Failures are retained, not waived.
No neural network has been enabled in production.
